title: PPO vs. SAC: A Comparative Study for Cooperative Motion Control of Dual-Arm Space Robots
abstract: arXiv:2610.32034v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growing population of orbital debris has intensified interest in active debris removal and on-orbit servicing, for which dual-arm space manipulators offer improved grasping stability and load distribution relative to single-arm systems. However, coordinating two manipulators under inter-arm collision avoidance, orientation alignment, and sensing uncertainty remains challenging. This paper develops a coordinated reinforcement learning framework for cooperative motion planning of a dual-arm space manipulator in a target-reaching task with inter-arm collision-avoidance constraints. A centralized state representation combines joint-space, end-effector, and target-relative information, while a multi-objective reward function promotes target-reaching accuracy, orientation alignment, motion smoothness, synchronized task completion, and collision avoidance. Within this framework, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Soft Actor-Critic (SAC)

translated_title: PPO与SAC：双臂空间机器人协同运动控制的对比研究
translated_abstract: 轨道碎片数量的不断增长加剧了人们对主动碎片清除和在轨服务技术的关注，而双臂空间机械臂相比单臂系统在抓取稳定性和载荷分配方面具有明显优势。然而，在臂间碰撞避免、姿态对准以及传感不确定性等条件下协调两个机械臂仍然极具挑战性。本文针对具有臂间碰撞避免约束的目标到达任务，开发了一个用于双臂空间机械臂协同运动规划的强化学习框架。该框架采用集中式状态表示，结合了关节空间、末端执行器以及目标相对信息，同时设计了多目标奖励函数，以促进目标到达精度、姿态对准、运动平滑性、任务同步完成和碰撞避免。在此框架内，对近端策略优化（PPO）和软演员-评论家（SAC）两种算法……
tldr: 本文提出了一个针对双臂空间机械臂协同运动规划的强化学习框架，通过集中式状态表示和多目标奖励函数，在具有臂间碰撞避免约束的目标到达任务中对比研究了PPO和SAC两种算法的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a coordinated reinforcement learning framework for dual-arm space manipulator cooperative motion planning, and comparatively evaluates PPO and SAC algorithms in a target-reaching task with inter-arm collision-avoidance constraints using centralized state representation and a multi-objective reward function.
